candidates.reason: Closest to the original: the quote, attribution and quote mark share one clean left edge, and the bleeding circle with the can keeps the feel. But the SOLSTICE logo is tiny and jammed into the bottom-left corner, off the text axis and only just below the attribution, and the can is a bit small inside its circle.

The quote block on the left reads well and the can-in-circle on the right suits the banner shape. But the SOLSTICE logo is blown up and dropped in the middle of the bottom edge, where it competes with the quote and is cut off from the attribution, which looks too small next to it. The full circle no longer bleeds off the edge as in the original.

The headline is squeezed into a narrow 4-line rag hugging the left edge, with an awkward 'a / glass' break. The attribution floats above the oversized centred logo, cut off from the quote it belongs to, so the reading order is jumbled. The middle of the banner is crowded while the right side is a big circle.

A shrunk copy, not a rearrangement: everything sits in a small cluster with large dead areas on both sides. The attribution and the SOLSTICE logo are illegibly tiny, the can label can't be read, and the circle is cut off at the bottom edge.
